138 NN ;; Heading.
140-147 DU ;; Decision table restating caching defaults (owners: performance.md, architecture.md).

C run007.semantics-first OL RUN-007,RUN-008 MUST ;; Define consistency semantics (staleness, invalidation) first and measure before caching solely for performance. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api001.output-cache-api OL API-001 DEFAULT ;; HTTP output caching, when the entire response is safely reusable, belongs in the API layer. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc024.abstraction-when-needed OL ARC-024,ARC-007,GOV-012 MUST ;; Define an Application cache abstraction implemented in Infrastructure only when a use case needs cache-aware behaviour; otherwise keep caching internal to Infrastructure. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run007.redis-justified OL RUN-007,ARC-020 MUST ;; Add a distributed backend such as Redis only when deployment requirements justify it (distributed caching is Reserved). ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc024.no-hybridcache-in-app OL ARC-024 MUST_NOT ;; Do not expose HybridCache itself from Application contracts (Infrastructure may implement the contract with it). ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.cache-central-keys EX RUN-020 DEFAULT ;; Centralize key construction when duplicated key formats become hard to maintain. ;; = ;; none ;; Key-construction organisation not in the oracle.
C x.cache-expiry-semantics EX RUN-023 MUST ;; Choose expiration from data semantics (change frequency, regeneration cost, staleness, memory, source-failure behaviour) rather than arbitrary universal defaults. ;; = ;; none ;; Forbids universal default TTLs; RUN-023 only requires some lifetime/invalidation.
C run023.no-unbounded OL RUN-023 AVOID ;; Avoid unbounded cache entries. ;; = ;; none ;;
C u.cache-preinvalidate LU RUN-021 ALLOWED ;; Invalidate before the mutation is known to have succeeded only when the workflow deliberately accepts that behaviour. ;; = ;; Deliberate acceptance. ;; Open question: is pre-success invalidation an exception relaxing RUN-021 ('only consistently with successful mutations') or consistent with it because it never makes the cache a source of truth?
C run020.output-cache-isolation OL RUN-020 MUST_NOT ;; Do not cache authenticated/user-specific responses unless key and policy isolate users and authorization context. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc016.no-bypass-invalidation OL ARC-016,ARC-024 MUST_NOT ;; Application Services keep the repository/UoW workflow and coordinate invalidation through an abstraction; never bypass repositories/IUnitOfWork for convenience. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.cache-failure-decision EX RUN-018 MUST ;; Decide whether a cache failure falls back to the source, fails the request or returns stale data. ;; = ;; none ;; Explicit failure-policy decision not in the oracle.
C x.cache-testing EX TST-003 DEFAULT ;; Test cache behaviour affecting correctness (invalidation after mutation, key isolation, miss fallback, outage policy); not framework internals. ;; = ;; none ;; Cache test obligations not in the oracle.
C x.cache-no-tracked EX RUN-021,ARC-016 MUST_NOT ;; Do not cache tracked persistence entities across Unit of Work boundaries. ;; = ;; none ;; Not stated in the oracle or in the cited owner rules.
C run021.not-authoritative OL RUN-021 MUST_NOT ;; The cache is not authoritative persistence. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run007.no-redis-default OL RUN-007,GOV-013 MUST_NOT ;; Do not cache by default without reason or add Redis merely because the application caches. ;; = ;; none ;;

165-169 DU ;; Check-by-reference list against verify § Delivery Changes and security.md (generic pipeline DB infra, YAML secrets, rebuilds per environment, suppressed tests, production seeding/startup migrations, assumed Docker/scripts); owner constraints captured there.

C x.cicd-artifacts-config EX WF-017 DEFAULT ;; Build deployable artifacts reproducibly and keep deployment/environment configuration outside compiled artifacts where practical. ;; = ;; Where practical. ;; Delivery technique outside the oracle (EXC-014).
C gov013.cicd-actual-stages OL GOV-013,WF-017 MUST ;; Add pipeline stages according to the actual project rather than generic boilerplate. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf017.cicd-discover OL WF-017,WF-001 MUST ;; Inspect the repository before writing a pipeline; do not assume a database, Redis, Docker or frontend tooling exists. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf007.cicd-format-adopted OL WF-007,WF-017 DEFAULT ;; Run formatting/analyzers in CI when adopted as enforced checks. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.cicd-no-new-gates EX WF-017 MUST_NOT ;; Do not turn an optional local formatter into a mandatory CI gate without the project adopting that policy. ;; = ;; Project adoption. ;; CI-gate restriction not in the oracle.
C wf018.cicd-npm-ci OL WF-018 MUST ;; Install from the lockfile with npm ci, then run the scripts the frontend defines (build; tests/lint when configured). ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf018.cicd-adapt OL WF-018,WF-017 MUST ;; Adapt action/runtime versions to the repository's supported versions; add frontend test/lint commands only when defined. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf017.cicd-services OL WF-017,GOV-013,TST-004 MUST ;; Provide external services in CI only when tests require them; no hardcoded provider in generic pipelines; integration environment isolated from Development/Production data. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf020.cicd-findings OL WF-020,GOV-014 MUST_NOT ;; Treat dependency findings per the project's security policy; no automatic CI upgrades unless automated updates are adopted. ;; = ;; Automated dependency updates adopted. ;;
C x.cicd-minimal-artifacts EX WF-017 DEFAULT ;; Store or publish only artifacts required by later stages. ;; = ;; none ;; Artifact retention rule outside the oracle.
C dep018.cicd-docker OL DEP-018 MUST_NOT ;; Build/publish images from CI only when the project deploys containers; do not add Docker because the skill supports it. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.cicd-build-once EX WF-017 PREFER ;; Prefer promoting the same tested artifact/image through environments over recompiling different production code per environment; environment behaviour from runtime configuration. ;; = ;; Promotion-capable deployment. ;; Build-once/promote preference is outside the oracle (EXC-014).
C sec001.cicd-secrets OL SEC-001,SEC-002 MUST_NOT ;; Use the CI platform secret/identity mechanism; never real secrets in pipeline YAML. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.cicd-federated EX SEC-002 PREFER ;; Prefer workload/federated identity over long-lived deployment credentials when supported. ;; = ;; Platform support. ;; Credential-type preference not in the oracle.
C wf019.cicd-migrations OL WF-019 MUST ;; Deployment migrations are explicit, use approved credentials, run at a controlled point and fail visibly; scripts may be generated earlier in CI. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.cicd-env-protection EX WF-017 DEFAULT ;; CI and CD may be separate; a green CI does not imply deployment; use environment protection/approval appropriate to the platform. ;; = ;; none ;; Deployment gating practice outside the oracle.
C x.cicd-verify-pipeline EX WF-017,SEC-001 MUST ;; Before a pipeline is complete confirm clean restore, backend build, frontend build when present, configured tests, no developer-machine dependence, no secret exposure and expected artifacts. ;; = ;; none ;; Pipeline completion checklist beyond WF-017.
